verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for a public web service like Companies House, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a robots.txt on any Companies House or GOV.UK host. The only related probe is an llms.txt 404, which is a different file and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
